name: natural-quit
purpose: iter-463 settings review finding 4, the A/B for femenu_quit.json with NO mod (-Gates SR_MODS=0): title -> START -> the game's own LOAD A GAME? popup -> A = START NEW GAME -> main_hud -> in game: START = pause menu (pulsed every 10 s for up to 3 min until the pause screen's [APT_SCREEN] request appears: the scripted opening ignores START) -> DOWN x8 = QUIT GAME -> A -> the WARNING popup's [APT_SCREEN] request (NO default) -> DOWN, A = YES -> StateAdapter.QuitGame -> the game's own return to the front end -> the title again -> START -> the sign-in read (XAM_PROFILE #3) and the natural popup again. Frames decide whether the reloaded ScrPressStart works (no mod log lines exist here). -TimeoutSeconds 600.

steps.name: pause
steps.purpose: START until the pause menu's own screen request appears (the scripted opening ignores START; quit_renum2). A pulse only repeats while the marker is absent, so an open pause menu is never toggled shut.

steps.name: down-to-quit
steps.purpose: Pause menu rows: RESUME, RESTART OBJECTIVE, SAVE/LOAD, STATISTICS, MOVES LIST, GAMEPLAY OPTIONS, CONTROLLER, AUDIO, QUIT GAME (btn9, 8 down).

steps.name: quit
steps.purpose: QUIT GAME -> ScrPauseMenu.showWarning -> FlowMgr.ShowGenPop: the WARNING popup's own screen request (fresh: ScrGenPop was already requested at the title).

steps.name: yes-quit
steps.purpose: YES -> StateAdapter.QuitGame -> the game's own return to the front end: the title screen's own request again (roll quit_verify/discover_natural1: seen=2 ~1 s after YES). Absent = quit signature A (no reload request).

steps.name: title-again
steps.purpose: Capture window: whatever the game shows after QUIT GAME.

steps.name: start-again
steps.purpose: START on the reloaded title: the sign-in read (XAM_PROFILE #3) proves the reloaded ScrPressStart takes input.

steps.name: popup-again
steps.purpose: Capture window: the natural LOAD A GAME? popup after QUIT GAME.
